arguments.summary: Commodities do not supply an independent directional signal on the supplied record. The evidence supports product-pricing and customer-infrastructure channels, but not a quantified energy/metals/raw-material-cost sensitivity for either issuer; QQQ holdings establish overlap only, not commodity beta.

claims.text: Micron reported raw materials and supplies inventory of $986 million as of May 28, 2026, within total inventory of $8.567 billion. This is a balance-sheet observation, not evidence of commodity-price pass-through, contract pricing, or margin sensitivity.

MU’s relevant commodity-like operating channel is memory product pricing and volume rather than a quoted energy or metals series: its published bear/base/bull sensitivity itself conditions residual EPS on weaker or stronger memory pricing, demand and margin. The Q4 outlook provides a near-term earnings/margin anchor, but does not disclose the price, input-cost, or elasticity data needed to attribute that outcome to a commodity driver.

NVIDIA disclosed $11.341 billion of raw-material inventory as of July 26, 2026 and states that its business depends on consistent, reliable supply from overseas partners, especially in Taiwan and South Korea. These facts establish a supply-input dependency, but not sensitivity to any specific commodity price.

For NVIDIA, customer data-center infrastructure is a more evidenced indirect constraint than a commodity price: it disclosed land, power and shell guarantees for select AI-cloud partners. A customer build delay or default could weaken deployment-driven demand assumptions; competing offsets include customer advances and disclosed data-center demand/outlook. The filing does not quantify the earnings consequence of power availability or guarantees.

QQQ’s dated September 18, 2026 holdings included NVDA at 8.535228% and MU at 5.012336%. This establishes issuer overlap with the two company channels, while the sponsor holdings data explicitly does not establish a commodity beta or a personalized portfolio exposure.

gaps.description: Neither supplied issuer disclosure quantifies energy, metals, wafer/material contract pricing, hedging, pass-through, or cost-of-revenue sensitivity. Therefore no current commodity-price shock or issuer-specific margin impact can be asserted.
QQQ holdings are a dated issuer composition view; they do not provide fund-level commodity beta or establish how a raw-material or power shock would transmit through all holdings.

assumptions: Memory product pricing is treated as an issuer product-cycle variable, distinct from a quoted oil, energy, or metals input.

A newly disclosed material cost-of-revenue, power-capacity, or customer-build constraint would be relevant over the 63-session horizon only if management links it to shipment, margin, or guidance change.
arguments.counter_thesis: The lack of quantified input sensitivity does not mean inputs are immaterial: both issuers hold raw-material inventory and depend on complex supply chains. A disclosed supply interruption, power-capacity shortfall, or inability to pass through higher costs could rapidly make this channel material, particularly for the assumed margin outcomes in the company scenario grids.

review_conditions.description: Reassess the commodities channel if either issuer’s next results, filing, or guidance identifies a specific raw-material/energy cost change, supplier disruption, or power/capacity constraint and quantifies an effect on gross margin, shipments, or outlook. A quantified adverse effect would weaken assumed margin/demand continuation; disclosed mitigation or no material effect would reduce this channel’s relevance.

shared_exposures.mechanism: QQQ’s dated holdings include both NVDA and MU, so an issuer-specific memory-pricing, supply-input, or customer-infrastructure development can transmit to QQQ through those constituents. This is dated composition evidence, not a claim of fund commodity beta or full-fund exposure.
shared_exposures.qualification: Weights are as of September 18, 2026; holdings can change and excluded cash/derivatives are separately reported.
